widgets_values:
Use the reference images to keep the same two fighters and the same visual identity.

The white-haired female boxer from IMAGE_0 and the black-pink-haired female boxer from IMAGE_1 are fighting in a professional boxing arena.

10-second cinematic fight sequence.

At the beginning, both fighters face each other in the boxing ring.
The white-haired fighter launches a powerful punch attack.
The black-pink-haired fighter performs a skilled defensive block with force redirection, using a ge dang xie li style movement, absorbing and redirecting the punch with realistic body rotation and footwork.

After the block, the white-haired fighter quickly changes position, closes the distance, controls the opponent’s arm and upper body, uses body leverage, and performs a clean shoulder throw (guo jian shuai).

The black-pink-haired fighter is lifted over the shoulder and falls onto the boxing ring floor realistically.
The white-haired fighter remains standing, confident and victorious.

Final moment:
The white-haired fighter raises her gloves in victory while the defeated black-pink-haired fighter is on the ground.
The audience reacts, arena lights shine, creating a dramatic championship fight atmosphere.

Style:
cinematic boxing match,
professional sports film,
dynamic camera movement,
realistic combat choreography,
strong impact,
realistic physics,
smooth motion,
high-quality action movie scene.

Camera:
dynamic tracking shot,
medium wide fight shot,
clear view of both fighters,
close-up during the block,
side angle during the shoulder throw,
final victory hero shot.

Keep:
same characters,
same hairstyles,
same outfits,
same identity,
realistic anatomy,
stable faces.

Negative:
changing characters,
changing hairstyle,
changing clothes,
extra fighters,
extra limbs,
deformed hands,
broken anatomy,
unrealistic floating,
blurred faces,
text,
logo,
watermark.
